transcriptionMethod: Factual cells transcribed from primary City of Vancouver PDFs as retrieved through web PDF extraction. Source spelling, roles, term-group rows, explicit dashes, component definitions and printed totals are preserved. The 2004 SOFI supplies cents; 2005-2011 annual-report tables supply whole dollars. Differences from printed totals are recorded, never corrected by adjusting a cell. No local PDF visual check is claimed: direct downloads returned HTTP 403.
